title: Pyramids built during the Saharan Humid Period

tellings.quote: I think they were built by the civilization that lived in Egypt during a period known as the Saharan Humid Period, which is from 8,500 BC to around 5,300 BC.

plain: The Egyptian pyramids were built by a people who lived in Egypt during the Saharan Humid Period, a wetter era that ran from about 8,500 BC to about 5,300 BC, according to a researcher named Jeffrey Drum. Drum gives this to Michels as his own view, without naming a source. If he is right, the pyramids would be thousands of years older than usually thought.
